component.name: ScreenStudio Pro
component.summary: Modern open-source screen recording for Linux

description.p: ScreenStudio Pro is a modern, open-source screen recorder built Wayland-first for riced desktops (Hyprland, niri, MangoWC, KDE). Capture a monitor, a window, or a region with mic and desktop audio, a webcam picture-in-picture, and hardware encoding (VAAPI/NVENC) with an x264 fallback.
Highlights in this prerelease (MVP scope — recording only):

ul.li: Monitor / window / region capture via the desktop portals
Mic and desktop audio meters with per-channel control
Pause / resume on a live take, and chapter-marker flags
Hardware encoders (VAAPI, NVENC) with x264 fallback
MKV capture with optional MP4 remux; library of recent takes

description.p: First public prerelease: recording core (capture, audio, encoders, library).
